description: On July 24th, by a vote of 93-66 the House passed H4860, the long-awaited police reform bill focused around use of force standards, the limiting of qualified immunity and the establishment of a P.O.S.T board, that will be used to mandate training for law enforcement officers in addition to the certification and de-certification of departments […]

title: Passing The House Police Reform Bill - State Representative Mike Day
